description: This file contains Swagger API documentation classes for the SelfShareAccounts API in the Fineract project, defining response and request schemas for share account operations.

classes.name: SelfShareAccountsApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Contains nested classes defining Swagger schemas for share account API responses and requests.

classes.name: GetShareAccountsClientIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for retrieving share accounts by client ID, including product and charge options.

classes.name: GetShareAccountsClientIdProductIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for detailed share account info by client ID and product ID, including accounting and reference details.

classes.name: PostNewShareApplicationRequest
classes.description: Schema for creating a new share application request.

classes.name: PostNewShareApplicationResponse
classes.description: Schema for response after creating a new share application.
